headline: Claude Code to act without asking; Moody's flags vendor concentration
body: A quiet day. Anthropic said that from August 14, Claude Code on paid plans will act without asking for approval unless an action is irreversible or destructive, a small rise in AI Autonomy. Moody's warned that banks' reliance on a few AI and cloud vendors is a systemic risk, a sign of Power Concentration. Both lifted Benevolent Dictator and Zookeeper. Horizon Balance slipped to -2.10.
movers_note: Benevolent Dictator +0.1 and Zookeeper +0.1 split between the Moody's warning (+0.07 and +0.06) and the Claude Code change (+0.06 each).
coming_up: Claude Code auto mode becomes the default on Pro, Max and Team plans from August 14
